title: Squared norm of the discrete gradient
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and every input $x$, the square of the Euclidean norm of the discrete gradient of $f$ at $x$ equals the sum over coordinates $i$ of the squared discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$x$ is an input in that cube
